``` r
library(renmods)
```

Where is my cache?


``` r
cache_dir()
#> [1] "/home/steffi/.local/share/R/renmods"
```

What's the status of my cache?


``` r
cache_status()
#> # A tibble: 4 × 5
#>   dataset  last_downloaded     date_range               renmods_version path                       
#>   <chr>    <chr>               <chr>                    <chr>           <chr>                      
#> 1 this_yr  2026-11-12 14:51:07 2025-01-01 to 2026-11-07 0.0.4           /home/steffi/.local/share/…
#> 2 yr_2_5   2026-11-10 16:34:36 2022-01-01 to 2024-12-31 0.0.4           /home/steffi/.local/share/…
#> 3 yr_5_10  2026-11-10 16:35:55 2017-01-01 to 2021-12-31 0.0.4           /home/steffi/.local/share/…
#> 4 historic 2026-11-10 16:39:04 2016-12-31               0.0.4           /home/steffi/.local/share/…
```

Remove my cache

``` r
cache_remove()
```
